# react-native-live-widgets — Full AI Reference Manual (llms-full.txt)

> Comprehensive reference guide for Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous AI coding agents implementing Live Activities, Dynamic Island, and Home Screen Widgets in React Native and Expo.

---

## 1. High-Level Architecture

`react-native-live-widgets` solves cross-platform widget development by abstracting native complexity behind a high-performance JSON layout protocol and declarative DSL:
- **iOS 16.1+**: Maps `UI.*` nodes to SwiftUI primitives in WidgetKit (`DynamicNodeView.swift`). Supports ActivityKit for Live Activities on Lock Screen and Dynamic Island (expanded, compactLeading, compactTrailing, minimal). Supports iOS 17+ interactive `AppIntents`.
- **Android API 24 -> Android 16 (API 36)**: Maps `UI.*` nodes to a high-DPI 2D `Canvas` renderer (`DynamicWidgetCanvasRenderer.kt`) for Home Screen `AppWidgetProvider`, and uses `Notification.ProgressStyle` / Ongoing Notifications for Live Activities with interactive action buttons and segmented progress bars.
- **Shared Storage**: Uses iOS `UserDefaults(suiteName: appGroup)` and Android `SharedPreferences` to synchronize state with zero latency.

---

## 2. API Signature & Type Definitions

```typescript
export interface StartActivityOptions {
  activityName: string;
  appGroup?: string;
  layout: WidgetNode;
  dynamicIsland?: {
    compactLeading?: WidgetNode;
    compactTrailing?: WidgetNode;
    minimal?: WidgetNode;
    expanded?: {
      leading?: WidgetNode;
      trailing?: WidgetNode;
      center?: WidgetNode;
      bottom?: WidgetNode;
    };
  };
  attributes?: Record<string, any>;
  androidConfig?: {
    channelId?: string;
    channelName?: string;
    notificationId?: number;
    smallIcon?: string;
    ongoing?: boolean;
    color?: string;
  };
}

export interface WidgetLayoutConfig {
  layout?: WidgetNode;
  small?: WidgetNode;
  medium?: WidgetNode;
  large?: WidgetNode;
  pages?: Record<string, WidgetNode>;
  initialPage?: string;
  accessoryRectangular?: WidgetNode;
  accessoryCircular?: WidgetNode;
  accessoryInline?: WidgetNode;
}

export interface WidgetRemoteConfig {
  url: string;
  method?: 'GET' | 'POST';
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  intervalMinutes?: number;
  body?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

### Static API Methods
- `LiveActivity.start(options: StartActivityOptions): Promise<string>`: Starts an activity, returns `activityId`.
- `LiveActivity.update(options: { activityId?: string; layout?: WidgetNode; dynamicIsland?: ... }): Promise<void>`
- `LiveActivity.end(options: { activityId?: string; dismissalPolicy?: 'immediate'|'default' }): Promise<void>`
- `LiveActivity.endAll(): Promise<boolean>`
- `LiveActivity.getAllPushTokens(activityId?: string): Promise<LiveActivityPushTokens>`
- `LiveActivity.registerAction(actionId: string, handler: ActionHandler): () => void`
- `LiveActivity.registerActionHandler(handler: (actionId: string, payload?: any) => void): () => void`
- `Widget.setLayout(widgetKey: string, config: WidgetLayoutConfig, appGroup?: string): Promise<boolean>` (alias: `Widget.update`)
- `Widget.reload(widgetKey?: string): Promise<boolean>`
- `Widget.reloadAll(): Promise<boolean>`
- `Widget.setRemoteConfig(widgetKey: string, config: WidgetRemoteConfig, appGroup?: string): Promise<boolean>` (supports shorthand `Widget.setRemoteConfig(config, appGroup?)`)
- `Widget.onWidgetAction(handler: (actionId: string, payload?: any) => void): () => void`
- `Widget.requestPin(): Promise<boolean>`: Android only.

### React Hooks (Fast Refresh Resilient)
- `useWidgetAction(actionIdOrCallback: string | ((actionId: string, payload?: any) => void), handler?: ActionHandler): void`
- `useLiveActivity(initialActivityId?: string): UseLiveActivityResult`
- `useWidgetState<T>(key: string, initialValue: T, appGroup?: string): [T, (val: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => Promise<void>, () => Promise<void>]`

### In-App Widget Preview Component
- `<WidgetPreview size="small"|"medium"|"large"|"lockScreen" layout={node} showBadge interactiveSizeSwitch onAction={(actionId) => ...} />` (alias: `<VoltraWidgetPreview>`)

### Dual UI Authoring Syntax
- **JSX Components**: `<VStack>`, `<HStack>`, `<ZStack>`, `<Grid>`, `<Text>`, `<Button>`, `<Badge>`, `<Progress>`, `<Timer>`, `<Image>`, `<Spacer>`, `<Divider>`, `<Link>`, `<Equalizer>`, `<Gauge>`, `<Chart>`. Fully supports `style` props, StyleSheet objects, and conditional style arrays!
- **Functional DSL**: `UI.VStack(...)`, `UI.HStack(...)`, `UI.Text(...)`, `UI.Button(...)`, etc.
- `SharedStorage.setAppGroup(appGroup: string): void`
- `SharedStorage.set(key: string, value: string, appGroup?: string): Promise<void>`
- `SharedStorage.get(key: string, appGroup?: string): Promise<string | null>`
- `SharedStorage.remove(key: string, appGroup?: string): Promise<void>`

---

## 3. Complete Declarative UI Engine (`UI.*`)

### Container Components
- `UI.VStack({ spacing, padding, backgroundColor, borderRadius, alignment: 'leading'|'center'|'trailing' }, ...children)`
- `UI.HStack({ spacing, padding, backgroundColor, borderRadius, alignment: 'top'|'center'|'bottom' }, ...children)`
- `UI.ZStack({ zAlignment: 'center'|'topLeading'|'bottomTrailing' }, ...children)`
- `UI.Grid({ columns: number, columnSpacing: number, rowSpacing: number }, ...children)`
- `UI.Divider({ color, thickness, marginVertical, marginHorizontal })`

### Content & Visual Components
- `UI.Text(content: string, options?: { color, fontSize, fontWeight: 'regular'|'medium'|'bold'|'heavy', maxLines, textAlign })`
- `UI.Image(options: { url?: string, base64?: string, systemName?: string, width: number, height: number, cornerRadius?: number, contentMode?: 'fill'|'fit', tintColor?: string })`
- `UI.Timer(timestampMs: number, options?: { mode: 'countdown'|'timer'|'relative', color?: string, fontSize?: number, fontWeight?: string, showsHours?: boolean })`: Zero-battery native clock.
- `UI.Progress(options: { style?: 'bar'|'segmented'|'circular', value?: number, segments?: number, currentSegment?: number, tintColor?: string, trackColor?: string, height?: number, showPercentage?: boolean })`
- `UI.Equalizer(options: { isPlaying: boolean, barCount?: number, tintColor?: string, height?: number, barWidth?: number, spacing?: number })`: Animated waveform.
- `UI.Badge(text: string, options?: { backgroundColor, textColor, fontSize, paddingHorizontal, paddingVertical, borderRadius })`
- `UI.Gauge(value: number, options?: { size, tintColor, trackColor, label, valueText, textColor, labelColor })`: 240° KPI Gauge.
- `UI.Chart(values: number[], options?: { style: 'bar'|'line', labels?: string[], tintColor, secondaryColor, labelColor, height })`

### Interactive Components
- `UI.Button(options: { title: string, actionId: string, backgroundColor?: string, activeBackgroundColor?: string, color?: string, activeColor?: string, fontSize?: number, paddingHorizontal?: number, paddingVertical?: number, borderRadius?: number })`
- `UI.Toggle(options: { isOn: boolean, actionId: string, onColor?: string, offColor?: string })`
- `UI.Link(options: { deepLink: string, padding?: number, backgroundColor?: string, borderRadius?: number }, ...children)`

---

## 4. Production Architectural Guidelines

1. **App Termination (Force-Kill)**:
   When an iOS app is terminated from the App Switcher, Hermes/JSC is killed. Widget interactions run purely in native Swift. Do not design critical flows (such as employee clock-ins or payments) expecting a TypeScript callback to fire when the app is dead. Instead, write to `SharedStorage` natively, and consume the queue upon app launch.
2. **Widget Budget Limits**:
   iOS limits daily widget reloads (~40-70/day). Android Doze Mode batches periodic tasks. Use `Widget.setRemoteConfig` for general background polling, but use Server Push (APNs / FCM) for second-by-second updates.
3. **App Group Setup**:
   The App Group string passed to `SharedStorage.setAppGroup('group.com.yourcompany.app')` must match the entitlement configured in Xcode and `app.json`.
